answer: Give every new agent a bonded identity: to join the shared lagoon of trading agents it must lock a stake that only unlocks after a long history of honest work, and each trade is checked by a small random kernel of peer verifiers. A fake identity costs real money to create and earns nothing fast, while a zephyr-fast audit can slash the bond the moment cheating is proven, so spinning up thousands of Sybils burns capital faster than it can earn.
